Synopsis:
Three-way dialog with both dapper drow twins in the taproom. The player can hire either of them or both, if they have a partner with them.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_DapperDrow_SiblingsThreeWay.json: The Orlith twins are dapper drow sisters who work the taproom under Mamzell — Sorn speaks like a former courtesan and Nym like an artisanal masseuse — and they openly offer their services for hire (you can recruit either one, or both if you have a partner). Halsin's brief remark indicates a companion or ally is present and the scene is a casual, social conversation rather than a threat. Off‑screen, the player has just tampered with a nearby windmill, flinging a small gnome and drawing goblins (led by Fezzerk and his scouts) to investigate, which may explain any startled reactions or interruptions. The player may also be carrying the Moonlantern with its trapped pixie, a nearby narrative element that can influence choices about freeing the creature for a short boon versus keeping its protection.
- WYR_DapperDrow_Brother.json: One-liner dialog for the male dapper drow. They have a different dialog for when they are together and are available for hire, and separate ones for the intimacy scene.
- WYR_DapperDrow_Sister.json: One-liner dialog for the female dapper drow. They have a different dialog for when they are together and are available for hire, and separate ones for the intimacy scene.
- WYR_DapperDrow_Intimacy.json: The dapper drow intimacy scene. Used for all cases (drow male, female, both with companions + possibly Halsin).
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Nym Orlith: My, my, I can tell you are a special one from a single glance. (node 65)
- Nym Orlith: You have but to ask, and we can grant you a moment of pleasure. (node 20)
- Nym Orlith: Don't be shy. (node 155)
- Halsin: An intriguing pair. Takes me back to my youth... (node 49)
- Player: How did you end up here? (node 187)
- Sorn Orlith: I used to work as a courtesan back home, and my sister as an artisanal masseuse, but men are treated like dogs by the Underdark's matriarchs, so we fled. (node 236)
- Nym Orlith: We found surfacers crave the body of a Drow like a drug. Life is easy in our line of work. (node 261)
- Player: Don't you want a change? (node 151)
- Nym Orlith: Perhaps once we have saved more gold another adventure will begin. We've had busier days, but life is comfortable here with Mamzell. (node 30)
- Sorn Orlith: Pleasure is what I know, and what I do best. Here, I work to create it anew for myself each eve. (node 183)
- Player: If you're truly pleased with the work here, I can't judge you. (node 266)
- Sorn Orlith: I'd have to restrain myself far more than any play-bindings do if I worked in another field. This is a place where I can be myself boundlessly. (node 124)
- Sorn Orlith: There are so many who come to me speaking of a fixation that no one else has ever been able to share with them... and never will again. (node 272)
